name: Fog Line
briefing:
## Situation
Midday in January, dense fog over the plains: visibility about 800 m. The camera will not see anything beyond that, in daylight or thermal. Our own patrol drones are up, and birds are working the fields.
## Mission
Detect, identify and defeat hostile drones before they reach Post Alpha. Leave birds, civilians and friendlies alone. Contact reports are expected: send one for every threat track (R).

## Intel
The radar and the RF detector are your eyes today. Use track behaviour (speed, height, heading toward the post) and RF to sort contacts early: by the time the camera can identify something, it is under a kilometre out.
